I find it darkly humorous that the Vance folks are furious about a “very online,” “campaign,” and/or “op,” against him. Don’t you understand that real Americans like him!? 

Never mind that Vance & Co. have been the most terminally online, twitter poisoned, faction of the Trump administration. He’s the “keep the cat memes flowing” guy, when it comes to demonizing Haitians legally in Ohio. But posting clips of Vance explaining his economic theories on TV? Cheap shots!!!
